component.name: Subtitle Edit
component.summary: A free, open source subtitle editor

description.p: Subtitle Edit is a free and open source subtitle editor. It supports hundreds of subtitle formats and provides editing tools including:

ul.li: Create, edit, and convert subtitles in hundreds of formats (SRT, ASS, SSA, VTT, STL, and more)
Sync subtitles to video using waveform or spectrogram view
OCR support for image-based subtitle formats (e.g. SUP/Blu-ray)
Batch conversion and fix common errors tools

description.p: This package repackages the official Linux x86_64 build published by the Subtitle Edit project, unmodified. libmpv (video preview) and ffmpeg (waveform extraction) are built into the sandbox, because the upstream tarball does not carry them.

Media in the standard XDG Videos, Music, Documents and Downloads folders is readable out of the box. A few further capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Open media stored anywhere else in your home directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home dk.nikse.subtitleedit
Open media on external drives or other mounts: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media dk.nikse.subtitleedit
